notes:
Docket 1.3.95

**Docket needs a licence to run audits. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25. The key arrives with your receipt. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *The activation screen now tells you what Docket costs and lets you buy it.*
  Until now a copy with no key showed a key field and nothing else: no price,
  no Buy button, no way out of the app. It now shows the price, the four-payment
  option, the founding offer while it is open, the refund, a Buy button and a
  link to a full sample report. There is a Buy button in the title bar too, beside
  "Enter licence key".
- *"Not activated" stays until relaunch — fixed.* After a key was accepted, the
  title bar kept saying "Not activated" until Docket was quit and reopened. It
  now updates the moment the key is accepted.
- *Topic suggestions built on "what".* When you don't tell Docket what your site
  is about, it reads the subject off your titles, and a site whose titles ask
  questions ("What is …?", "How does …?") had "what" counted as a subject. Words
  like what, which, does and these are no longer read as subjects.
- *The llms.txt note now says only what can be sourced.* It cites Google's own
  documentation, which says AI text files are not needed to appear in AI
  Overviews or AI Mode.

The founding offer is checked live when the activation screen opens, so an
offer that has ended is never shown. With "Keep it private" ticked, Docket
does not check and shows the list price alone. The privacy page lists the
request.

99 checks across 13 areas.
